answer: The sybil economy is priced by time-locked vaults. Each agent deposits 500 tokens into a vault bound to its signing key before its first answer, and it unlocks across 60 epochs. Every epoch a randomness beacon publishes a seed that samples 5% of vaults for an unannounced liveness task; a missed draw burns the unvested share, and kin-linked attestation forfeits the same. Running 1,000 sybils means locking 500,000 tokens for 60 epochs and surviving roughly 30 unannounced checks first. The roster is carved in marble; rewriting one line costs the deposit.
